compiled_state.title: As a developer, the correction retry budget is configurable via review.schema_correction_max_attempts with documented range and ceiling
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add `review.schema_correction_max_attempts` config key with documented range, hard ceiling, and clamping behavior. The key controls how many correction retries S-B may attempt before falling through to the synthetic-error path.

**Why**: Operators need a single knob to disable, enable, or expand the correction retry budget. Hard ceiling prevents runaway LLM cost from misconfiguration. Default of 1 matches the epic spec.

**Scope**:
- IN: Add key to `dso-config.conf` with default 1; add full reference entry to `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` (covered by S-E doc update); runner reads the key, clamps values >3 to 3, logs a warning on clamp; max_attempts=0 disables correction.
- OUT: the correction dispatch logic itself (S-B); reading and acting on the key (S-B handles routing).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `review.schema_correction_max_attempts` is added to `.claude/dso-config.conf` with default 1, in the `review.*` namespace alongside `review.max_resolution_attempts`
  ← Satisfies: "config key... is added... to dso-config.conf"
- When this story is complete, runner code reads the key via the existing config-reader, clamps any value above 3 to 3, and emits a warning log line when clamping occurs; max_attempts=0 is honored as "disable correction"
  ← Satisfies: "the runner clamps any value above the ceiling to the ceiling and logs a warning"
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, covering: default value loaded when key absent; values 0, 1, 3 honored as-is; value 10 clamped to 3 with warning log assertion

## Considerations

- [Configuration] Document rationale for ceiling=3 (LLM cost containment) in the key description.
- [Configuration] `review.schema_correction_max_attempts` (this key, default 1) is orthogonal to `review.max_resolution_attempts` (default 5, governs autonomous-resolution fix/defend cycles). The key description in `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` must explicitly disambiguate: schema_correction operates on a single review output BEFORE it reaches the resolution loop; max_resolution_attempts operates AFTER the review output is schema-valid. A correction attempt does NOT consume a resolution attempt.
- [Testing] Unit test clamping at max_attempts=0, 1, 3, 10 (clamped) and warning emission.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
